name: Sit Anywhere!
statusMeaning: In the catalogue, not checked yet.
author: SozoKa
description:
Sit anywhere you want! Look down, double tap sneak and right click and you sit. As easy as that. Or you can just sit on stair/slab or via "/trigger sit".
Work on vanilla servers, or any other setup.
evidence: Data only, no Java code: Horizon's mod browser imports its data; nothing for Kiln to run.
